2014_spells.circle-of-death.description: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in that area must make a constitution saving throw. A target takes 8d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
2014_spells.circle-of-death.effectSummar: Deal 8d6 necrotic damage to a target within 150 ft
2014_spells.circle-of-death.fullDescript: Using 1 action, a sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. A target takes 8d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
